title: The Hidden Mystery
description:
Deep inside an abandoned research facility lies a strange machine that studies numbers. Whenever numbers are entered, the machine produces its answer. The researchers who discovered it could not determine what happens inside the machine.

The rule behind its response is hidden. Study the examples carefully, uncover what the machine is looking for, and reproduce its answer for any given sequence.
input_format: The first line contains an integer N. The second line contains N integers representing the sequence.
output_format: Print a single integer representing the hidden value produced by the system.
